title: The CCMC
description: About The CCMC CCMC specializes in HOA community management for large-scale, master-planned communities across the U.S., offering tailored services that prioritize the unique vision and goals of each community. With over 50 years of experience, they provide financial oversight, governance guidance, and lifestyle-driven operations to enhance community living. Their innovative BUURT technology platform enhances communication and operational efficiency for residents and boards alike. CCMC partners with property developers and HOA boards to create vibrant communities that foster connection and belonging As a result of the attack on The CCMC, more than 25 GB of confidential data was stolen. This data includes more than 50,000 files containing property and maintenance documentation, documents related to owners and tenants—including personal data—financial reports, banking information, and other important company information.
